body: It looks a bit paranoid to specify viewBox, width/height _and_ explicit size on img. Personally, and depending how compatible with old browsers I'd have to be, I would probably just keep the viewBox and the width of the ``.
dominant-baseline still not implemented in Edge, but I think that's just a matter of time.

+<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 150" width="480" height="150">
body: Omitting the height of the img element ought to cause a relayout when the SVG has loaded, right? Never fun when long specs scroll around during loading.
What will happen without it? Text all moved up half a line height?
We already use it in asyncdefer.svg, so I think the policy is just that Edge gets a slightly degraded experience.

I just went for consistency within the repo...
